objective: Implement durable paired healing with parallel reasoning, resource-scoped fenced mutation, BDA reinspection, independent Auditor verification, and Guardian-controlled closure while preserving the existing healer substrate.
implemented: JointHealingOrchestrator for exactly two distinct paired healers.
Resource/conflict-grouped mutation scheduling using existing RepairDependencyAnalyzer semantics.
RepairLockManager mutation leases with fencing epoch and action-scope validation.
Bounded compensation using existing healer rollback actions.
BDA reinspection and typed reinspection events.
Production HealerEngine routing for high-risk/non-local incidents when enabled by AutonomousFactoryController.
Wave-3 focused workflow and compatibility tests.
security: The incident itself is not globally locked; mutation resources are leased.
Action scope is validated against the mutation lease.
BDA evidence is required before closure.
Auditor evidence is required before closure.
Only the floor Guardian can authorize closure.
ResolutionGate still rejects incomplete resolution proof.
